content.comment_body: Hello everyone, hope you're all well. I'm having trouble setting up a Modbus connection between [company_name] [product_name] and a third-party PLC (JUMO700). When I connect my [company_name] controller to a PC as both master and slave, it works fine. However, connecting to the JUMO700 doesn't work, and I suspect incorrect settings are the cause. While I matched the essentials—same port (502), correct IP address—I'm not sure about the variable address. JUMO700 uses hexadecimal addresses, and [product_name] only accepts decimal, so I converted the hex address to decimal for the settings, as you can see in the attachments. Attached are details of my configuration. Thanks in advance.
Hello. Do you know how to send analog input values from JUMO700 to [product_name] [version_no] using Modbus?
Could you share more details? Which specific values do you want to read?

Hello. JUMO700 provides 8 temperature values through PT100 analog inputs. We're interested in importing these readings into [product_name] [version_no]. Can you explain the procedure? Thank you for your assistance.

Which [product_name] module are you using? Please provide the full [article_no]. Can you also specify which register addresses correspond to the 8 temperature readings, and whether they are Input Registers or Holding Registers?
How do I complete the settings page for JUMO700 and for [product_name] [version_no]?
We're using [product_name] [version_no] [article_no]. The registers in question are Input Registers.
Are you referring to these addresses?
From the table, I only see 6 temperatures listed, not 8.
The remaining temperatures are shown further down the table.
I can't confirm without knowing the exact model number.
We finally resolved it. Thank you for all your help.

analysis.insight_summary: Users faced difficulties configuring Modbus communication between [company_name] [product_name] (specifically [version_no]) and JUMO700, with primary issues around incompatible address formats (hexadecimal vs. decimal) and register type selection. While PC integration was straightforward, differences in device protocols caused problems. The conversation indicates limited user experience with network and Modbus configuration, as well as confusion about transferring PT100 analog temperature data from JUMO700 to [product_name].
analysis.user_expectations: Users are looking for simple, clear instructions for connecting [product_name] with JUMO700 using Modbus, including guidance on converting and mapping address formats, and successful transfer of temperature data. They want detailed configuration steps or templates for both devices to enable effective data exchange.
